source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of debugging techniques (PDF 63-64).

items: Print statements: code ke alag alag stages (hisson) par print laga kar variables ki values dekhna.
Debugging tools: pdb (Python Debugger) jaise tools se code step by step (ek ek line) chalana, variables inspect karna (andar jhaank kar dekhna) aur program ka flow (chalne ki tarteeb) samajhna.
Error messages: error messages parh kar samajhna ke problem kahan se aa rahi hai.

blocks.text: Misaal: divide function ko zero denominator (neeche wala number, jis se divide karte hain) ke saath call kiya jata hai, jis se ZeroDivisionError aata hai. try-except block ghalti pakar kar error message print karta hai, jis se problem pehchanne aur sambhalne mein madad milti hai.

Wazahat: divide do numbers ko divide karta hai. 10 ko 0 se divide karne par ZeroDivisionError aata hai; except usay e naam se pakar kar Python ka apna message ("division by zero") ke saath print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Yeh program kya message print karta hai?

blocks.text: Yeh program marks ka average (ausat) nikalta hai aur har qadam par DEBUG wali print line se total aur count dikhata hai, jaise print statements se debugging hoti hai. marks ki list badal kar Run karein aur har qadam ki values dekhein.

marks = [70, 85, 90]
total, count = 0, 0
for mark in marks:
    total = total + mark
    count = count + 1
    print("DEBUG: mark =", mark, " total =", total, " count =", count)
average = total / count
print("Average =", average)

items: Debugging ke tareeqe: print, pdb, error messages.
